exec.scenario: When a fill-shot action is invalid due to hand constraints or wrong argument order, and the agent is stuck in a think loop.
exec.experience: If a fill-shot action fails, check valid actions to learn the correct hand order and required free hands. Then execute the necessary leave/grasp actions immediately instead of repeatedly thinking. Avoid infinite think loops by committing to the next concrete action.

exec.scenario: When executing a multi-trip transport plan that carries two objects per trip using both grippers.
exec.experience: Track the remaining objects after each drop and continue the pick-move-drop-return loop until every object has been delivered; do not stop mid-trip after dropping only one of the two carried objects.
